# Pull Request Review

- [ ] Scope and user need are clear.
- [ ] Changes match actual project architecture.
- [ ] No secrets, real résumés, or identifying information added.
- [ ] Data provenance and license considered.
- [ ] Upload and external API behavior reviewed.
- [ ] Model labels and preprocessing checked, where relevant.
- [ ] Automated tests and manual checks recorded.
- [ ] Error/loading/accessibility states reviewed.
- [ ] Docs, diagrams, changelog, and model card updated.
- [ ] Known limitations are stated honestly.
